info.title: Novel Reading Web API
info.description: A comprehensive API for a novel reading platform similar to Wattpad, featuring user management, story creation, reading lists, and social features.

username.description: Unique username (3-20 characters, letters, numbers, underscores only)

password.description: Password (8-128 characters with uppercase, lowercase, number, and special character)

dateOfBirth.description: Date of birth (optional, user must be between 13-120 years old)
Date of birth (optional, user must be between 13-120 years old)

newPassword.description: New password (8-128 characters with uppercase, lowercase, number, and special character)

followedUserId.description: ID of the user to follow

followingUserId.description: ID of the user who is following

followedUserId.description: ID of the user being followed

publishedAt.description: Publication date (optional, cannot be in the future)

userId.description: User ID who owns the list

storyCount.description: Number of stories in the list

get.description: Check if the server is running and healthy

post.description: Authenticate user and return access token

get.description: Retrieve user profile information by ID

put.description: Update user profile information (users can only update their own profile)

403.description: Forbidden - can only update own profile

put.description: Update user password (users can only update their own password)

400.description: Current password is incorrect or validation error

403.description: Forbidden - can only update own password

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the user who wants to follow

400.description: Bad request - validation error or already following

403.description: Forbidden - can only follow from own account

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the user who wants to unfollow

400.description: Bad request - validation error or not following user

403.description: Forbidden - can only unfollow from own account

get.summary: Get users that a user is following
get.description: Retrieve list of users that the specified user is following
Retrieve list of users that follow the specified user
Retrieve published stories with advanced filtering, searching and sorting

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: Search keyword in title and content

parameters.name: includeTags
parameters.description: Tags/genres that stories must include (multiple parameters: includeTags=romance&includeTags=scifi)

parameters.name: excludeTags
parameters.description: Tags/genres that stories must exclude (multiple parameters: excludeTags=adult&excludeTags=horror)

parameters.name: includeTagLogic
parameters.description: Logic for include tag filtering (and = all tags must be present, or = any tag must be present)

parameters.name: excludeTagLogic
parameters.description: Logic for exclude tag filtering (and = exclude if all tags present, or = exclude if any tag present)

searchExample.description: Search for romance and fantasy stories, excluding adult content
